transcript.text: Is it normal for my dishwasher to leave everything wet? Plastic tubs are soaking every time and there's drips on the glasses. It's a Bosch Serie 4.
This helps distinguish between a drying issue and a heating problem. Please let us know: At the end of a normal programme, are the dishes and the inside of the door hot (with some steam), or cold?
Yes, it's hot and steamy inside at the end of the cycle. The water seems properly hot during the wash too.

Thanks for letting us know about the heat. Rinse aid is what makes water run off so the dishes dry — check the rinse-aid indicator or cap next to the detergent flap, top it up if it's low, and check the setting isn't on the lowest level. Was the rinse aid empty or set low (and have you sorted it), or was it already full and set normally?
The rinse aid was empty, the refill symbol is lit on the display. I use all-in-one tablets so I never put any in separately. Should I fill it up?

Please run a normal programme on your Bosch dishwasher to see if that resolves the issue. Once it has finished, check whether the glass and china are drying properly. Are the dishes coming out dry now, or still wet?
I haven't run it yet, I was asking whether I should fill the rinse aid up first. Should I fill it and then run a normal cycle? I've been using Eco 50 every time.

[Heading: Rinse aid]
Thanks for letting me know about the cooler programme and that we haven’t retested yet. Based on what we’ve seen, the issue is most likely linked to the rinse aid, although the programme choice could also be a factor. The check itself is straightforward. Please carry it out and let me know what you find if it doesn’t resolve the problem.
Sorry, I'm a bit lost. Do you want me to fill the rinse aid compartment up and then run my usual Eco 50 cycle to see if the drying improves?

Thanks for letting me know. No problem if you haven't had a chance yet. Rinse aid is what makes water run off so the dishes dry — check the rinse-aid indicator or cap next to the detergent flap, top it up if it's low, and check the setting isn't on the lowest level. Was the rinse aid empty or set low (and have you sorted it), or was it already full and set normally?
It was empty, the refill symbol is lit and I haven't filled it yet. So shall I fill it up and then run my usual Eco 50 to see if it dries better?
Now run a normal programme again. Are the dishes coming out dry now, or still wet?
